input.summary:
parts/facade.mjs builds the street face: front door with transom and stone step, both shop windows with breast, counters and open shutters, upper and attic glazing, two flower boxes, five jetty brackets, two Mann braces, the hoist beam with chain, barrel and loft shutters, the Bäckerei sign arm, and the two lanterns under the jetty (74 cells, 0 refused, 0 off-palette).
A front zoom render reads as the plan intends; the sign and hoist are too small in the views to confirm closely.
plan.md checklist and six elements.md items ticked; make.sh writes a whole build.nbt.

waste.what: Looked up each helper's facing convention by reading vocab/h1-h4 source (shutterPair faceDir, mannBrace toward, flowerBox pot parity) to decide the arguments.
waste.tool: A one-line signature list with the facing meaning for each helper in the kit (e.g. 'shutterPair faceDir = wall side the plate lies against; mannBrace toward = post the back faces') would have saved the reads.

waste.what: Checked each part's cells by hand against plan.md's facade table (which cells are already built, which are open) and wrote the facade calls from it.
waste.cost: about 40 coordinates checked by reading, plus one retry-free build
waste.tool: A `mcd plan`-style census of the open cells of a facade plane (the windows and door cells part 1 left unset) would turn the table into a checked list.

waste.what: Confirmed the hoist and sign by eye from a zoom render; no tool reports whether a sign's text was actually written or whether a shutter lies flat against its wall.
waste.cost: 3 renders and zooms, judged by eye
waste.tool: `mcd check` could accept an expected-hanging list so the intended orphan barrel is not reported, and a per-block 'lies flat against wall' test for trapdoors.

left: Lanterns elements item left unticked: the two under the jetty are built (P4), but the lanterns by the back door and the wing door belong to P6.
Mann braces at (7,8,8) and (15,8,8) face west and east (toward the nearest post on each panel's outer side); plan.md did not give facings, so this is my reading.
mcd check reports the hoisted barrel at (11,16,5) as an orphan. This is the intended hanging load on the chain, not a fault, but the check cannot be told to allow it.
The sign text 'Bäckerei' was passed to signArm but I did not verify it was written into the block entity; the zoom render is too small to read text.
The hoist beam and loft shutters at the apex are visible only as a small detail in the front views; not checked at close range.
